title: OpenAI Says ChatGPT Is Safer for Teens. Now It Needs to Show Proof.
summary_en: Now, when OpenAI's system predicts that an account belongs to someone under 18, teen protections are automatically applied without waiting for a parent to activate them. But even ambitious efforts can fall short, and the public needs a way to discover when they do.
title_cn: OpenAI Says ChatGPT Is Safer for Teens. Now It Needs to Show Proof.

title: Hardening Critical Infrastructure Software in an Era of Rapid AI Advancement: An Urgent Call for Coordinated Action
summary_en: This paper provides expert analysis on artificial intelligence–accelerated vulnerability discovery and the structural hardening of critical infrastructure software.
title_cn: Hardening Critical Infrastructure Software in an Era of Rapid AI Advancement: An Urgent Call for Coordinated Action
